title: CBDT Initiates Nationwide Verification of Suspicious Foreign Remittances
content:
# CBDT Initiates Nationwide Verification of Suspicious Foreign Remittances

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Department ne nationwide verification drive launch ki hai for suspicious foreign remittances. Yeh verification exercise August 18, 2026 ko shuru hui hai.

*   **Kya ho raha hai:** The Income Tax Department ne data analysis aur ground intelligence ke basis par kayi suspicious entities ko identify kiya hai, jinhone pichhle teen saalon mein large amounts of foreign exchange remit kiye hain. Yeh entities ya toh non-filers the ya unka reported turnover remitted amounts se match nahi kar raha tha.
*   **Focus areas:** Is verification drive ka main focus shell entities, unke peeche ke individuals, aur woh professionals hain jinhone Form 15CB certificates (jo ab Income-tax Rules, 2026 ke under Form 146 ho gaya hai) issue kiye the.
*   **Scope:** Approximately 394 entities, including 117 entities jo land-border states mein located hain, aur 36 professionals ko is exercise mein cover kiya gaya hai.
*   **Advisory for Professionals:** Department ne emphasis kiya hai ki Form 15CB/Form 146 certificates issue karte waqt CAs ko proper due care, diligence aur professional judgment exercise karna chahiye. Underlying transactions aur relevant facts ko acche se examine karna bahut zaroori hai.
